original_source_locator: Exact primary perlecan/FGF2 neural-stem-cell paper; no SCI-transfer or direct receptor-binding inference.
verified_source_locator: Results—FGF-2 stimulation of neurogenesis is impaired in the absence of perlecan; Neural stem cells express perlecan and can bind FGF-2 in vitro; Perlecan regulates FGF-2 promotion of neurosphere formation. Discussion—An extracellular matrix niche for neurogenesis.
source_section_or_locator: Primary Results/Discussion sections verified against linked PMCID full text.
source_figure_or_table: Figure 5 (in vivo cyclin D2/Akt/Erk1/2); Figure 6 (perlecan/HS/CD133/FGF-2 localization); Figure 7A–G (neurosphere formation, Akt/Erk1/2, cyclin D2, author model).
observation_text: In Hspg2-deficient rescued mice and derived neural-stem-cell models, FGF-2 increased Akt/Erk1/2 activation, cyclin D2 expression, and neurosphere formation in controls, whereas these responses were absent or reduced without perlecan.
claim_text_or_blocker: The authors conclude that perlecan is a critical extracellular-matrix component of the adult neurogenic niche that regulates FGF-2-dependent signaling and self-renewal/neurogenesis; this is functional niche evidence, not a direct HSPG2–FGFR1 binding claim.
model_species: Mus musculus; Hspg2−/−-Tg and WT-Tg mice; adult SVZ and E16.5 cortex-derived neurospheres
assay: SVZ immunoblot after FGF-2 stimulation; neurosphere formation/count/size; phospho-Akt, phospho-Erk1/2, and cyclin D2 immunoblot; perlecan/HS/CD133/FGF-2 immunofluorescence
perturbation: Hspg2 deficiency; FGF-2 ICV stimulation in vivo and graded FGF-2 in vitro (0, 20, 200 ng/ml)
outcome: Perlecan deficiency attenuated FGF-2-induced signaling and neurosphere formation and was associated with reduced neural-stem-cell maintenance/neurogenesis.
grading_basis: B retained from the integrated queue: the primary mouse experiment supports perlecan-associated FGF-2 cellular function in a CNS neural-stem-cell niche. No direct HSPG2–FGFR1 assay, SCI-repair phenotype, or terminal-TF evidence was found; no grade upgrade.
exclusion_or_blocker: excluded_from_direct_edge_promotion; local artifact is abstract-only and lacks Results/Discussion/figure text; figure-level review used the linked primary PMCID full text.

original_source_locator: Exact HSPG2/perlecan–FGF2/FGFR1c primary study retrieved; direct HSPG2–FGFR1 binding was not inferred.
verified_source_locator: Results—FGF-2 binding is mediated by rhPln.D1 HS but not CS; Mitogenic activity of rhPln.247 and rhPln.198. Discussion—FGFR1c co-receptor activity and glycan-dependent relay.
source_section_or_locator: Primary Results/Discussion sections verified against linked PMCID full text.
source_figure_or_table: Figure 6 (FGF-2 ligand blot); Figure 7 (solid-phase FGF-2 binding); Figure 9A–C (HUVEC/BaF32 mitogenic activity).
observation_text: Recombinant human perlecan domain-1 species bound FGF-2 in ligand-blot and solid-phase assays with an apparent K_D of 2.0 ± 0.2 nM; heparinase III, but not chondroitinase ABC, largely reduced ligand-blot binding, and perlecan D1 augmented FGF-2-dependent proliferation of FGFR1c-expressing BaF32 cells.
claim_text_or_blocker: The authors interpret HS-decorated recombinant perlecan D1 as an FGF-2 co-receptor/relay component that augments FGF-2 signaling through FGFR1c in the BaF32 assay; the study does not establish direct HSPG2–FGFR1 binding.
model_species: Recombinant human perlecan D1 (rhPln.198/rhPln.247); recombinant human FGF-2; FGFR1c-expressing BaF32 cells
assay: FGF-2 ligand blot; solid-phase binding; MTS proliferation assay in FGFR1c-expressing BaF32 cells
perturbation: Heparinase III or chondroitinase ABC digestion; rhFGF-2 ± rhPln.D1; FGFR1c-transfected BaF32 assay
outcome: HS-dependent FGF-2 binding to recombinant perlecan D1 and an FGFR1c-associated mitogenic response were demonstrated in recombinant/cell-line systems.
grading_basis: B retained from the integrated queue: the primary recombinant/cell-line experiments support an HSPG2/perlecan-HS–FGF-2–FGFR1c receptor-proximal relay. Direct HSPG2–FGFR1 binding, intact full-length perlecan behavior, and SCI relevance were not demonstrated; no grade or context upgrade.
exclusion_or_blocker: excluded_from_direct_edge_promotion; local artifact is abstract-only and lacks Results/Discussion/figure text; truncated recombinant domain and glycosylation context remain bounded.
